name: inspira-warp-background
blurb: Coloured light beams streak downward with perspective, creating a warp effect.
description: Motion-based beams with randomized hue animate downward through a perspective viewport. Supports customizable beam count per side and animation speed.
use_when: A dramatic, immersive background for hero sections or pages with a hyperspace or warp theme.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users — continuous downward beam animation may cause discomfort. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
a11y: Wrapper component with content slot; focus and keyboard behaviour come from overlaid children.
